content: Rohan Ahuja contacted insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to inquire about reinstating his health policy. Sunita informed him that he needs to pay a total of ₹25,000 (₹23,000 outstanding premium plus a ₹2,000 reinstatement fee) and provided a payment link. Rohan confirmed he would make the payment immediately and asked if the policy would become active right away.

action_items: Customer to pay the total due amount of ₹25,000 using the provided payment link
Agent to confirm policy activation status after payment
